mcp-refusals.title: Typed MCP refusals
mcp-refusals.boundary: POST /api/story with feature=mcp-refusals returns structured steps. Offline capture replay, companion 22: pii-request and pii-response-sse raise PIIDetected with request/response phase; the latter is HTTP 403 JSON, not an SSE error event. abac-denied/global-access raise ToolNotInProfile. schema-invalid-args and poisoning-block-list stay native generic errors, not guessed policy types. times=1 then uses the baseline. Injection is method-wide and rewrites RPC IDs, not byte-verbatim. Safe PII projections omit raw values; raw diagnostics remain sensitive. No live framework/policy certification.

steps.title: pii-request
steps.detail: phase=request; flagged values withheld. The next call succeeds from the offline baseline (times=1).

steps.title: pii-response-sse
steps.detail: phase=response; flagged values withheld. The next call succeeds from the offline baseline (times=1).

steps.title: Access-profile denial
steps.detail: HTTP 200 is not success: JSON-RPC -32008 denies access. No retry.

steps.title: Schema validation / tool poisoning
steps.detail: Framework errors remain untyped: generic JSON-RPC codes do not identify a policy. Raw diagnostics are not displayed.

tool-lockfile.title: Pin the gateway-visible tool catalog
tool-lockfile.boundary: POST /api/story with feature=tool-lockfile runs an offline lock/discover/bind story (companion 23). Unchanged catalogs bind; changed descriptors raise ToolLockDrift(kind=changed), removed tools tool_missing, and absent servers server_missing. New tools are excluded as unpinned, not drift; a missing/invalid lock is ConfigError before discovery. Server keys ignore version. Provisional, offline-verified in SDK 0.2.1; no live lock round-trip. The lock detects drift, never grants access.

steps.title: Pin the gateway-visible catalog
steps.detail: await donkey.tools.lock() writes deterministic descriptor hashes; repeated bytes match.

steps.title: Changed description
steps.detail: Before binding: changed. Review the change before re-locking.

steps.title: Removed tool
steps.detail: Before binding: tool_missing. Review the change before re-locking.

steps.title: Missing server
steps.detail: Before binding: server_missing. Review the change before re-locking.

steps.title: Added, unpinned tool
steps.detail: delete_all is excluded as unpinned; get_stock and reserve_item still bind. Drift detection is not authorization.

a2a-outbound.title: Outbound A2A send & stream
a2a-outbound.boundary: POST /api/story with feature=a2a-outbound returns steps and spans (companion 24). send returns SendMessageResponse; stream yields StreamResponse inside async with. v1 Azure captures raise ContentSafetyBlocked; v1 send/stream and v0.3 send rate captures raise TokenBudgetExceeded. PII is ToolInvocationError, not PIIDetected: its echo is absent from error text and spans, but raw response is sensitive. Disable official SDK tracing before import or explicitly opt in. Provisional, offline-verified; successful gateway send/SSE not verified. No retry, OAuth completion or remote task cancellation.

steps.title: Delegate with send()
steps.detail: Official SDK message from a synthetic offline reply. HTTP success does not imply a completed task.

steps.title: Delegate with stream()
steps.detail: Official SDK events: message. Closing the stream does not cancel the remote task.

steps.title: azure-block-send
steps.detail: provider=azure-content-safety; categories=['prompt_shield']. Captured gateway block, replayed offline.

steps.title: rate-stream
steps.detail: retry_after=60.0; no automatic replay of the delegated request.

steps.title: pii-send
steps.detail: Generic JSON-RPC refusal, not PIIDetected. Exception text and spans omit echoed PII; the raw response remains sensitive.
